about.metadataDescription: Learn about AcresxManna, an export-focused Nigerian agro-processing and food manufacturing business.
about.heading: We believe Africa should capture more value from its agriculture.
about.intro: AcresxManna is an export-focused agro-processing and food manufacturing business. We connect agricultural sourcing with processing, product development and market access. Local retail in Nigeria is planned through shops and the UncleTobi online grocery concept.
about.storyHeading: More value can be created after harvest.
about.storyParagraph1: Africa has significant agricultural resources, yet much of the value in the food economy sits in what happens after harvest. We believe more of that value can be captured through processing, manufacturing, packaging, quality control and competitive food brands.
about.storyParagraph2: Through our Nigerian operations and UK-facing business, we're building the foundations for a stronger link between African food production and international markets. We understand both sides: the realities of sourcing and processing in Africa, and the quality, consistency and commercial needs of the markets we want to serve.

about.visionText: To become Africa's leading agro-processing and food manufacturing company, recognised globally for scale, quality, innovation and the value we create from African agriculture.

infrastructure.metadataDescription: How AcresxManna is building production, quality assurance and supply chain capacity for African food manufacturing.
infrastructure.heading: Building the capacity behind African food.
infrastructure.intro: Our ambition needs more than agricultural supply. It needs production infrastructure, people, systems and partnerships to turn raw materials into consistent, market-ready food. AcresxManna Ltd manufactures and exports from Nigeria; we are building further capability as demand, investment and readiness allow.

impact.spotlightImageAlt: Farmer inspecting high-yield dwarf hybrid papaya trees
impact.spotlightText: Through partnerships with local growers, we introduce dwarf hybrid crop varieties, pest-resistant seed stock, and protected shade structures. This boosts harvest volume per hectare and shields farming families from climate volatility.
impact.scorecardText: We only publish verified data. The figures below will be updated as we receive and confirm each metric from our operations team.
impact.closing: We want our growth measured not only by the products we sell, but by the productive capacity and economic opportunities we help create.
